module_constraints.syncGroup: subscribe-first; closure-scoped cutover state (liveBuffer: NostrEvent[], cutoverComplete: boolean); OVERLAP_SECONDS=60 module constant with comment referencing Design Decision 3; filter becomes (since?: number) => Filter; groupSubs.set/subs.push precede request()
module_constraints.ingestLock: preserved (AC-A-6) — buffer drain goes through ingestGroupEvents (the lock-protected path)
module_constraints.syncedEventIds: preserved (AC-A-4) — dedupes events that arrive both via subscription overlap and historical request

seam_impact: none — receive engine internals only; no module boundary crosses

new_module_scope_constants.name: OVERLAP_SECONDS
new_module_scope_constants.rationale: Design Decision 3 in spec.md: sized for end-user clock skew (mobile/desktop clocks drift tens of seconds), not dev-host sub-second skew. 60s provides 60000x margin over the macOS sub-second concern (GAP-5).

new_closure_scope_variables.name: t0
new_closure_scope_variables.description: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) at sync start — the since-bridge cutover timestamp

new_closure_scope_variables.name: liveBuffer
new_closure_scope_variables.description: Holds live subscription events while historical fetch is in flight. Drained in created_at order after historical ingest completes.

new_closure_scope_variables.name: cutoverComplete
new_closure_scope_variables.description: Flips to true after buffer drain. Subsequent live events bypass the buffer and go directly to ingestGroupEvents.

s2_hooks_preserved: sub-event trace record (moved into the new subscription callback, preserving epoch at receipt)
